channel.title: Swapnil Chauhan
channel.description: Essays, engineering notes, and programming write-ups by Swapnil Chauhan.

item.title: Apple, please open up iOS
item.description: Apple makes incredible hardware. I want an iPhone I can shape with agents, without waiting for the next major iOS release.

item.title: A note on Hiking
item.description: Living in California comes with countless places to hike, and I fully intend to make good use of that privilege.

item.title: Lessons from three years as a software engineer in London
item.description: A reflection on three years of software engineering in London, and the next chapter: moving to the San Francisco Bay Area for a Master's in Engineering Management.

item.title: The AI Codebase
item.description: AI makes it easier than ever to add code quickly. But I keep wondering what happens when nobody truly understands what has been added.

item.title: Plateauing
item.description: A reflective essay on growth, ambition, and what it feels like when progress gets harder to measure.

item.title: Pickle DNS - A Recursive DNS Resolver in Rust (Part 1)
item.description: An introduction to DNS fundamentals and the first steps of building a recursive DNS resolver in Rust.

item.title: Procrastination and the Fear of Not Being 'Good Enough'
item.description: A personal piece about writing, self-doubt, and the quiet ways perfectionism can stall creative work.

item.title: Titanic Disaster Neural Network using Tensorflow and Google Colab and uploading it to Kaggle.
item.description: A walkthrough for building a Titanic classifier in TensorFlow, training it in Colab, and submitting predictions to Kaggle.

item.title: Guidelines, Roadmap and Resources for beginner to advanced iOS app development using Swift
item.description: A curated roadmap and set of resources for learning iOS development with Swift from beginner to advanced levels.
